title: Spicy Charred Corn Pico
summary: Charred corn salsa with crunch, freshness, and heat for almost no fat. Charring the corn is what gives it depth.

ingredients.raw: 1.5 cups corn (charred in a dry hot pan or grilled, off the cob or thawed frozen)
1 jalapeño (or serrano for more heat), minced

steps.body: Dice the red onion and mince the jalapeño. Quarter the tomatoes, juice the lime, and chop the cilantro.
Char the corn in a dry hot pan (or grill it) until spotted dark in places.
Toss the charred corn, onion, jalapeño, tomatoes, lime juice, and cilantro together and season with salt. Let it sit at least 10 min.

notes.body: **Char the corn first.** It's what gives the pico its depth
**Let it sit.** Ten minutes is enough for the lime and salt to pull the flavors together
